events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up built as a brownstone-inspired recharge stop with hair and beauty touch-ups, a photo booth, legwear displays, coffee and personalization.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups and the photo booth are advertised as free. Skincare sampling is also advertised. Embroidery is tied to purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree that the pop-up is open to the public September 12–13 from 12–5 PM. Free embroidery is not a no-purchase freebie: NYC for FREE states it requires purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs. Other promotional services and samples remain subject to on-site availability.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, September 12–13, 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No RSVP or host-approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.address: Yaya Tea, 206 Grand St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A public launch event previewing Claire's upcoming Yaya Tea collaboration, with an interactive claw machine and first-come promotional giveaways.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests are advertised to receive a complimentary Yaya x Claire's boba drink plus one item from the collection. The event itself is open to the public while supplies last.
events.caveats: The first-50 boba-and-product giveaway is quantity-limited and not guaranteed after that cutoff. Current event listings say the event is open to the public and runs while supplies last. No RSVP or approval step is published.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–3 PM at Yaya Tea's Little Italy location, 206 Grand Street. Kids are welcome according to the current listings.
